profile.headline: Software Engineer at Regal
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack software developer based in Lexington, KY passionate about close collaboration with product and design as well as flexible software architecture. I invest as much into code quality as I do curious and compassionate team culture. 
 
Most recently I led cross-platform delivery at Hudl, building mobile and web experiences in React Native and TypeScript, establishing a shared frontend component pattern other squads adopted, and prototyping internal AI tooling. Before that, I designed a JSONSchema-based form architecture at Panorama that turned multi-hour, code-blocking form updates into something anyone could do in minutes, on full stack Rails applications serving educational professionals. Across both roles I've worked with microservice architecture, GraphQL, REST APIs, and AWS, and with distributed, global teams.
 
I'm proficient in TypeScript, React, React Native, C#, Ruby, and GraphQL and familiar with .NET, Claude Code, and Python. I pride myself on how quickly I ramp up in new tech stacks and know enough AWS to be dangerous.
 
When I'm not coding, you'll find me playing tabletop roleplaying games, dabbling in arts and crafts, or placating my rambunctious puppy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Researched and drove a parent-centric Personalization initiative for Hudl Fan, influencing a strategic pivot to prioritize the main Hudl app over maintaining both products.
- Planned and led squad delivery of a closed-beta athletic event experience for parent users in the Hudl app, owning scope and cross-functional coordination.
- Established the internal pattern for cross-platform frontend component packages using React Native for Web.
- Delivered cross-platform favoriting for Hudl Fan across React Native, web, and legacy APIs; built supporting analytics to track adoption and registration impact.
- Integrated third-party mobile ticketing into the Hudl Fan React Native app.
- Prototyped a Claude Code plugin for generating and analyzing weekly Tech Ops reports.
- Mentored an engineering intern through the favoriting feature on web, and guided a junior engineer through pairing on Snowplow analytics integration for the athlete event page experience.
- Instituted daily ice breakers in standup, cultivating community and belonging within the squad.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React Native · TypeScript · Braze · .NET Framework · Apollo GraphQL · GraphQL · Snowplow · Claude Skills · Microservices · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented third party data integration in Ruby with a user-facing Vue UI for critical school districts.
- Investigated and fixed two high-priority security vulnerabilities for SOC2 evaluation.
- Planned and implemented JSONSchema-based form configuration architecture for student behavior logging, allowing for near-instant code-free form updates.
- Augmented prototype for beta AI Student Insights feature.
- Supported Client Experience to resolve technical issues as part of regular support rotation.

- Integrated recent Xometry code into acquired company's legacy codebase.

positions.description:
- Engineered specific solution for Angular-based feature toggles that was the base for a generic solution for other Angular features.
- Spearheaded testing initiative for the Mobile Web Applications as part of the company testing guild.
- Headed development on mobile version of existing desktop web application using past experience.

positions.title: Technical Rotation Program - Software/Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
As part of this rotational program, I did three different rotations to gain experience in different technical parts of development at Lexmark. 

First Rotation - Full Stack Developer for Web Applications
- Extended Angular applications for better user experience and further functionality.
- Engineered automated building and packaging of a standalone Angular application.
- Diagnosed client's issue with pre-existing software and led client through the solution.
- Implemented extensive integrated testing framework for newly merged functionality.

Second Rotation - Software Dev Ops
- Automated dependency-based ordering when deploying services.
- Pair-programmed and debugged with a remote engineer regularly.
- Automated cleaning up AWS resources for EKS and ECS stacks.
- Led coworkers through proper development practices and design principles.

Third Rotation - Mobile Solutions
- Utilized experience from first rotation to implement and refine functionality from desktop web application for mobile experience.
- Bridged gap between corresponding desktop application team with mobile team to avoid confusion.
- Introduced linting and simplified proof of concept code to keep code base manageable.

organizations.description: As the social chair of LINKED, I am responsible for planning social events to better integrate young professionals into the workplace as well as allow for better networking opportunities within and outside Lexmark. I participate in quarterly meetings with the other chairpeople to discuss future events.
